name: 건설 중
summary: 건설을 누르면 하단 메뉴가 작은 건물 목록으로 바뀝니다.
prompt:
Edit the supplied minimal TownGrid gameplay screen into a different interaction STATE of the exact SAME MINIMAL DESIGN. Preserve the complete same game map, all buildings and trees at the same coordinates, same camera, same screenshot boundaries, and the two very small resource/time groups at the TOP corners exactly. Keep sharp actual pixel art. Do not restore any previous ornate interface. Matte deep teal #193f42, warm ivory, restrained flat orange, 1px edge at most, 3px corner radius, clean Korean sans type. NO rivets, no bevels, no metallic shine, no framed cards, no heavy borders, no added full-screen title, no new sidebar, no quests, no notifications, no camera toolbars. All changes occur in a compact BOTTOM-CENTER tool area. There must still be only THREE UI groups: top-left resources, top-right time/menu, bottom-center active tool. The default bottom three-action dock is REPLACED by the active tool, never shown below it as a duplicate. Minimalism must survive interaction. Do not label it as a poster or specimen: a single actual full gameplay mockup. Exact same landscape 16:9.

STATE: CONSTRUCTION PICKER OPEN. Replace the bottom '시장 / 건설 / 세계' dock with ONE low horizontal construction tray, approximately 640px wide by 135px tall on this 1672px screenshot, bottom center 20px from the edge. Teal matte background, subtle thin rim only. The top line is text tabs '기초', '생산', '운송'; selected 기초 is indicated by a short orange UNDERLINE, not a giant button. At far right a small close X followed by tiny 'Esc'. Below, just FIVE lightweight building options in one row: small pixel icon '창고' coin80, small flat dirt-tile icon '흙길' coin4, well icon '우물' coin60, small orange lumber-workshop icon '벌목장' coin90, quarry icon '채석장' coin100. Use compact 40-48px icons and single concise labels underneath. No individual card borders, no big cream card backgrounds, no descriptions, no locks, no extra sixth item, no selected-building detail panel. One row, one tray. Keep just enough padding for legibility, not a huge catalog. Optional small slim '전체 ›' text at the lower far right to access remaining categories but do not create another control bank. Leave map completely clear above the tray, no selected tile or building highlight. No inspector anywhere. The image should feel almost as calm as the minimal idle reference; the expanded UI occupies under about 7% of the canvas by area.
